integrity: The primary public PDF was inspected at the product joint CDF, Eq. (2.4) survival definition, bivariate/truncated survival discussion, Proposition 1 conditional hazard, Eq. (3.6), and the empirical survival interpretation. The 2025 same-object precursor and an independent discrete-bivariate survival reference were also inspected. The event identities are exact and the bundled checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The finding corrects multivariate event interpretation and does not challenge the univariate Wiener-range marginal construction.
The at-least-one-exceedance probability remains meaningful but must not be interpreted as simultaneous co-exceedance.
The source figures are not regenerated; their event interpretation follows from the formulas used to define them.
title: The discrete Wiener-range paper confuses union exceedance with joint survival
